annotations.title: Ask the phone to render a post's video

description: Ask the person's iPhone to render a post's current video edit: now (as soon as the app is open) or charging (while the phone charges). The phone renders it: this leaves the request for the phone's next sync (if the phone fails or is closed, the server renders a fallback from the phone's proxies). versions renders the hook versions too. edit_get's render.state turns rendered when the phone reports back; then look at the result with edit_frames.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

versions.description: Render each hook version as well
